homonyms.basis: 'Pessoa Archive' is card 3's English name for this edition (B3, item 2) and the archive's name, in #761, for Pessoa's estate at the Biblioteca Nacional de Portugal ('the Pessoa Archive at the Biblioteca Nacional de Portugal', the Espólio de Fernando Pessoa), a distinct entity that card 3 lists separately (item 1, F26) and the census's negative tags exclude ('NOT Pessoa's estate or papers'). The PKG working plan's description of the edition as 'digital archive of Pessoa's Espólio' (D669-01) joins the two; it is composed as a contradiction (P_coh), and the two stay distinct entities. T reached the edition (the registry's per_dim: reached 'same'); no card is a homonym's.
distinct_entities: the Espólio de Fernando Pessoa (N3) at the Biblioteca Nacional de Portugal, the estate's papers, 'the Pessoa Archive' in #761 (B3 item 1; F26)
the MultiPessoa portal, of which the Arquivo Pessoa is one part (F13)
the Labirinto, the portal's other part, with readings of 120 poems (F13)
the 1997 CD-ROM MultiPessoa — Labirinto Multimedia, the original edition (F11, F40)
Casa Fernando Pessoa, co-publisher of the 1997 edition (F40)
the Digital Edition of Fernando Pessoa (pessoadigital.pt), a separate census row (F27; LS-22)
the Book of Disquiet Archive, Modern!sm and Fernando Pessoa's Private Library (F27)
the archive's seat pessoa-full (EA-CORPORA-11), a corpus derived from the edition (D1565-01, D1711-01)
pessoagraph.org, the archive's Pessoa graph, which links to the edition (D669-04)

captures.description: THE EDITION, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Arquivo Pessoa is a digital library and database dedicated to the published work of the Portuguese writer Fernando Pessoa.' Key details: arquivopessoa.net; origin ('Created between 1997 and 2008 by the Institute of Studies into Modernism at Lisbon's Universidade Nova, directed by Leonor Areal, and evolved from an earlier 1997 multimedia CD-ROM'); contents ('Pessoa’s poetry, prose, heteronyms, and orthonyms'), five categories listed; features (search, the 'Labirinto' with 'audio readings and images'). Three cards: the edition's home and Info pages, Art and Soul Group. The paste ends on the third card.
